newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe says Thomson-CSF decision due before end-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Juppe says Thomson-CSF decision due before end-Feb.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe on Thursday reiterated that the government would announce a decision on the privatisation of Thomson-CSF before the end of February.

"Before finalising the government's decision on the procedure of the privatisation of Thomson-CSF, the Prime Minister has today received the concerned ministers Jean Arthuis (Finance), Franck Borotra (Industry) while Charles Millon (Defence) was represented by his chief of staff," a statement from Juppe's office said.
It said Juppe met afterwards with Marcel Roulet, chairman of Thomson SA, followed by Serge Tchuruk, chairman of Alcatel Alsthom, and finally Lagardere Groupe chairman Jean-Luc Lagardere.
"The government will take its decision before the end of the month of February," the statement added.
